title: Technology Sector Update for 10/15/2018: HRS, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG - Nasdaq.com
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: -0.46%
AAPL: -0.43%
IBM: +0.10%
CSCO: +0.20%
GOOG: +0.07%
Technology stocks were mixed in early Monday trading.
Sector news include:
(+) Harris ( HRS ), which was up 6% after reporting significantly improved results for fiscal Q1 compared with the year-ago quarter, beating expectations compiled by Capital IQ. It also raised its earnings guidance for fiscal 2019.
(+) Apple was down 0.34% after reports that it has acquired Asaii, a startup that developed a music analytics engine for artist managers and music labels, and Goldman said the company faces slower consumer demand in China, which could hurt IPhone sales.
